rationale: The agent followed policy throughout: it answered the general catalog question using product tools, then authenticated the user via full name + zip and matched to a single account. It retrieved the user’s orders, correctly identified the two pending orders containing t-shirts, and asked for explicit confirmation including the exact change details and the payment method for any price difference. After receiving confirmation, it used the modify tool to change only the specified t-shirt items to the requested variant and reported accurate price differences consistent with the tool outputs. It did not act on any other accounts or items and provided correct final information. No unsupported claims are evident, and all actions align with the policy requirements.
